steps: Set environment variables: export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/anthropic && export ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN=ac96a781bad141808246da37f274d99a.1w0Oib3gCblk4rC3 && export ANTHROPIC_MODEL=glm-4.5-air
Process all failing YAML files that have good MD content (>500 chars) using extract_yaml.py. Process them in batches by domain to avoid overwhelming the API. The following 43 files need regeneration:

BATCH 3 - legal (3 files): domains/legal/chatlaw.md, domains/legal/tongyi-farui.md, domains/legal/powerlaw-ai.md (if not deleted)

BATCH 6 - automotive (3 files): domains/automotive/haomo-drivegpt.md, domains/automotive/lixiang-mindgpt.md, domains/automotive/wayve-lingo.md

Run extract_yaml.py for each file one at a time with a small delay between calls to avoid rate limiting
After each batch, run validate.py to check progress

IMPORTANT: The extract_yaml.py --all flag will process all files but skips those with <100 char MD. Since we already deleted garbage files, running --all should be safe. However, it will also re-process files that already pass validation, which is fine (they may get improved data).
